reviews.text:
This article was written after receiving meals from a company through an experience group.

Today I went to Yuklab Gangnam main branch. It is a meat restaurant with a nice atmosphere located near Sinnonhyeon and Gangnam Station, where you can enjoy both beef and lamb. The atmosphere of the store was like a luxurious wine bar, making it perfect for dates or quiet gatherings.

We ordered the rib set, and it included real ribs, lamb ribs, and seasoned ribs, so we were able to enjoy it in a variety of ways. The quality of the meat was good, so I could clearly feel the difference in each flavor and texture, and the scent was really good throughout the grilling process.

I went to the Gangnam Main Branch of Beef Lab, a great place to enjoy beef in a nice atmosphere at Gangnam Station. The black-toned exterior has a clean and sophisticated feel, making it a great place for dates or gatherings. Inside, there was plenty of space between tables, so I was able to eat comfortably.

The menu I ordered that day was garlic beef ribs, sirloin, and to finish, kimchi fried rice.
Garlic beef ribs are a dish made by marinating the area between the ribs with garlic seasoning. The garlic flavor is subtle and not overpowering. When grilled over a fire, the garlic and meat aromas come out together to really enliven your taste buds. The unique chewiness of the rib meat is still alive but not tough, and it is clean without being greasy, so it goes really well with drinks.

The menu explains that sirloin is the part attached to the ribs and is the most popular part of beef. When I actually tried it, the marbling was spread evenly, making it juicy, and the savory flavor came out well when grilled over charcoal. I was satisfied with just a pinch of salt.

For drinks, I ordered a beer and a highball, both of which went well with the meat. In particular, the highball was not too carbonated and went well with the garlic beef ribs. The kimchi fried rice I ate at the end had a rich flavor from the meat oil, and was a dish I kept reaching for even when I was full. reviews.text:
Top-notch Korean BBQ you can experience in the heart of Gangnam.

If you are looking for authentic, high-quality K-BBQ near Gangnam Station, this is the place. ‘Yukpum’ is a place that goes beyond your average meat restaurant, focusing on expertly aged pork.

Meat: The quality stands out.

720-Hour Aged Pork Belly: This is their signature dish, and for good reason. The aging process creates an incredibly deep flavor and a texture that is crispy on the outside and incredibly juicy on the inside. It's completely different from regular pork belly.

Iberico pork shoulder: Incredibly tender and melts in your mouth like premium beef. This is a must-try menu.

Specialties: What makes this place truly special is the variety of specialties. ‘Shell anti-jeongsal’ is truly a new discovery. The combination of crispy grilled skin and soft yet chewy meat is a feast of textures that cannot be easily found anywhere else.

Atmosphere and service: The restaurant is modern, spacious and very clean, with a good ventilation system (no need to worry about smells getting on your clothes). The staff is professional and attentive, and they grill the meat to perfection right at your table, which is a big plus for those who are not familiar with K-BBQ.

Recommendation: Perfect for any occasion, including dinner with friends, dates, and business meetings. The price is reasonable, and you can experience quality that makes sense for the price. Don't miss this gem!

This is a Blue Ribbon restaurant that I visited for the first time for a company dinner and liked it so much that I went back with my mother.
It was a room restaurant that had taste, atmosphere, and privacy, so it was great to enjoy a leisurely meal, and all of the courses were satisfactory.

Not only is the food delicious, but even the plating is really beautiful, making it a great place to visit on a special day. I could feel the care put into each dish, enough to satisfy the taste buds of my mother, who is good at cooking, and I was able to enjoy a variety of flavors thanks to Gouga's secret sauce. My mother was very satisfied with the meal, so I was also proud :)

The ingredients were fresh, and the various sauces added a deep flavor. I think it would be even better with corkage free wine. The staff is friendly and the store atmosphere is nice, so I have 100% intention to visit again.

If you make a reservation for your birthday or anniversary, they will even provide sparkling wine, lettering, and Polaroid photos, so it would be nice to have an even more special time :)

Bongwoo's Two-story House I've been singing about how delicious it was for a long time, and I finally came here and it was really delicious.
Be sure to eat crab ramen together. It's not just ramen, it's crab seafood ramen that you eat with a rice cake... All the meat is grilled and the service is the best.

reviews.author: Noel Lee
reviews.text: I went there after hearing that the meat tasted good, but when I actually tried it, I was satisfied. It was convenient to grill the meat yourself, and it was nice that the cooking speed and condition were adjusted well. The store wasn't too noisy, so I didn't feel like I was busy eating, but I was able to eat slowly and talk. Overall, I thought it would be a good place to come for a gathering or with friends as it had a casual atmosphere.

reviews.author: Park Ji-seon
reviews.text:
I've been coming here often from the beginning, but it's even cleaner and the meat is really delicious!!!!! I really like the upgraded look~~
Every time I come, I fall in love with the taste of meat♡
Be sure to eat jar cold noodles together!!!!!

reviews.author: Hwang Won-seop
reviews.text: This is a popular meat restaurant near Gangnam Station! Cold noodles in a jar are also so delicious! Highly recommended! The store is spacious, so it would be great for a company dinner! Eat well and eat well~

reviews.author: dabok dabok
reviews.text:
This place had really good meat quality.
I was very satisfied with the Korean beef grilled over charcoal fire because it was soft and juicy.

The store is clean and the staff are friendly, so it feels like a good place for gatherings or company dinners!
If you like meat, this is a place worth visiting at least once.

reviews.author: Seo Kyung-jo
reviews.text: This is a meat restaurant in Gangnam Station that has particularly delicious beef and pork belly. The thin beef pork belly meat is soft and the side dish and perilla leaf combination is also good. It's spacious and clean, so it's good for gatherings, and the cold noodles are said to be good, so I'd like to try it.

reviews.author: Jun J
reviews.text:
Dongchimi Naengmyeong? It’s a little spicy but delicious! (No spicy food allowed)
The dongchimi soup that came with it was delicious, so I ordered it and it was really delicious. It's not easy to find delicious dongchimi at a restaurant these days.
The meat is also delicious. I'm still trying to cook the neck meat, but the beef pork belly is delicious even for me, who doesn't like beef,~~

reviews.author: Mintchibob
reviews.text: The atmosphere is great and the prices are reasonable in the commercial area of Gangnam Station! The side dish bowls are neat and tidy and very delicious. The raw meat is especially delicious...💗💗

address: 2nd floor, 13 Gangnam-daero 100-gil, Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

reviews.author: What about latte?
reviews.text:
The hall was very spacious and there wasn't much smoke from the meat. I made a reservation and received soybean paste stew as a service. It was delicious. The meat was first primed and cooked and placed on a small plate next to me so I could eat it comfortably.
It's a bit busy so they can't be there all the time, but the meat was delicious.

reviews.author: Playtube
reviews.text:
I ate diced gabri and galmaegisal, and the quality of the meat was really good.
The diced rib meat was chewy and juicy, and the galmaegisal meat had an impressive savory flavor.
It was clean and free of odors, so it was nice to enjoy it without any burden.
The staff were friendly and I had a pleasant meal.
This is a place I want to visit again next time! 😊

reviews.author: Alzartakarcen
reviews.text:
The truffle flavor of the meat was mediocre because I don't like truffles, but the quality of the meat itself was good and delicious.
When I ordered meat, the staff grilled it well and kindly explained that it tastes better if you dip it in salt. The atmosphere of the store is just like that of a meat restaurant, but it is warm and the bathrooms are clean. They seem to be well-maintained. I like Damongjip, a restaurant near Gangnam Station.
There was a wait of about 40 minutes, but it was worth the time.

reviews.author: zero
reviews.text:
Is there anyone who still hasn’t been to Gangnam Station’s famous restaurant, Damongjip?
The steamed food is so delicious that I want to stamp my attendance three times a week!
All kinds of real meat are soft and juicy, so I am satisfied every time I come, and the staff are all friendly 😭 Satisfying place!
The prices are reasonable and the menu is varied so you can try a variety of things, making it a great place to recommend for group dinners or gatherings!
Don’t hesitate and visit!!!!🩷🩷

reviews.author: Jaeto
reviews.text: I visited Damong House at Gangnam Station! The atmosphere was clean and the staff were friendly, so I had a pleasant meal :) The meat was of good quality, so it was juicy and grilled gently and without any unpleasant smell. Especially since they baked it themselves, the baking was perfect. Each of the side dishes were neat and delicious, so it was great to eat with the meat. The soybean paste stew they gave us was rich and savory, so it goes perfect with rice! Overall, I was satisfied with the taste, service, and atmosphere. Next time I want to come again with my friends 👍
